title: Employee News Spread Time
statement:
Given a management tree and each manager's forwarding delay, compute when the last employee hears the news.

Contract
- `n` is the number of employees labeled `0` through `n - 1`.
- `headId` is the root manager. `manager[i]` is `-1` for the head and otherwise names employee `i`'s direct manager.
- When an employee is informed at time `t`, they inform each direct report at time `t + informTime[i]`.
- Return the earliest time by which every employee has been informed. The management relation is a valid tree.

Examples
`minutesToInformAll(1, 0, [-1], [0])` => `0`
`minutesToInformAll(6, 2, [2,2,-1,2,2,2], [0,0,1,0,0,0])` => `1`
`minutesToInformAll(7, 6, [1,2,3,4,5,6,-1], [0,6,5,4,3,2,1])` => `21`
hints: Build the direct-report lists from the manager array.
The time to a report is the manager arrival time plus that manager's inform time.
A DFS or BFS from the head visits each employee once and tracks the maximum arrival time. Intended complexity: O(n) time and O(n) space.
inputSyntax: Input: n headId manager array then informTime array, for example: 6 2 [2,2,-1,2,2,2] [0,0,1,0,0,0]
